Nothing satisfying as a delicious Indian cuisine dinner!
Dec 2024 • Family
Nothing satisfying as a delicious Indian cuisine dinner! 

We indulged in aloo chat as appetiser. It came in an interesting different style.

As main course, we had gobi manchurian, baingan bharta and kadai paneer. It was accompanied with butter naan, garlic naan and a unique chilli coriander naan.

We ended with the finale of perfectly brewed masala Indian tea.

Such lovely food and good service. Will definitely return...

Managed to Perfection, this is The Curry House for Me
Dec 2022
It took me a while to get here so I was somewhat disappointed when the owner told me I'd have to wait 30 minutes to order because they were full. And they were! As the former owner of one of the most famous restaurants in the Caribbean I had to hand it to the guy, he put the customer first, not, come in , sit down, take your order and then let you wait an hour for food. He was upfront, knew his kitchens capacity and didn't want to break it for a few dollars more.
I waited with a beer, then ordered Sheekabab followed by ChickenMadrass and Garlic Nan. All delicious and served with speed and precision.
Congrats, I'm impressed and wish you another 22 years, wonderful to eat non a place with an owner as professional as you-Lance
